name: Moroboshi Kyouko
source:
Kyoko is the loving and caring stepmother of Ryuichi, but is also the reason why Ryuichi moved out in the first place. A defenseless and heavy sleepwalker who finds herself in Ryuichi’s bed almost every night ever since the passing of her husband.

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/sweet-home]JAST USA[/url]]
